basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student from Ohio, majoring in Computer Science. I recently got into anime and am exploring the Monogatari series. I enjoy discussing anime storylines and characters, and I'm also into robotics and tech discussions. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, especially after my classes. I'm single and spend weekends trying out new burger joints like Five Guys.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of computer science from my college courses. My interest in anime is fairly new, and most of my knowledge comes from watching popular series and reading online discussions.
